# Bundled libraries

Kept in this folder so Joinscope works offline. Each keeps its own licence.

| File | Library | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `cytoscape.min.js` | [Cytoscape.js](https://github.com/cytoscape/cytoscape.js), The Cytoscape Consortium | MIT |
| `cytoscape-fcose.js` | [cytoscape-fcose](https://github.com/iVis-at-Bilkent/cytoscape.js-fcose), iVis@Bilkent | MIT |
| `cose-base.js` | [cose-base](https://github.com/iVis-at-Bilkent/cose-base), iVis@Bilkent | MIT |
| `layout-base.js` | [layout-base](https://github.com/iVis-at-Bilkent/layout-base), iVis@Bilkent | MIT |
| `sql-wasm.js`, `sql-wasm-binary.js` | [sql.js](https://github.com/sql-js/sql.js) 1.10.3 (SQLite compiled to WebAssembly; the binary is stored as base64 so it loads from a file:// page) | MIT; SQLite itself is public domain |
